referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A large, uncaptioned interior photograph leads, followed by a left-aligned studio proposition and a small black work action in a separate white band. A compact wordmark and thin, widely spaced project, studio, services and contact links sit on a plain white top row. Restrained modern sans; modest but confident headings, narrow body measure and generous vertical whitespace let the rooms carry the visual weight. The page sequence runs from image-led opening to studio promise and work action to integrated process split toward awards text field, project conversation, minimal footer. Large architectural photographs alternate with quiet text blocks; a low, horizontal row of project thumbnails acts as an index. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
